nodes.name: NF Cleaning Etching Growth
nodes.procedure: A piece of commercial NF (3 cm×1 cm) was first cleaned by ethanol and deionized (DI) water with the assistance of ultrasonication for 15 min each. Afterward, the clean NF was immersed in HCl (3 M) for 1.5 h to etch the surface, followed by an immersion treatment in DI water for 24 h at room temperature to grow uniform nanosheets.

nodes.name: Fe Ion Exchange
nodes.procedure: The Ni(OH)₂/NF was first soaked in a 0.1 M aqueous iron nitrate solution (2 mmol Fe(NO₃)₃·9H₂O dissolved in 20 mL DI water) at room temperature for 1 h. After the ion-exchange process with Fe cations was complete, the light red (Ni,Fe)(OH)₂/NF precursor was obtained.

nodes.name: Phosphidation
nodes.procedure: 120 mg red phosphorous powder was placed upstream in a tube to serve as the phosphorous source. Subsequently, the as-obtained Ni(OH)₂/NF precursor or (Ni,Fe)(OH)₂/NF precursor was placed at the center of the tube and was phosphorized under an Ar stream at 450°C for 1.5 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows interplanar spacings of 0.221, 0.167, and 0.508 nm corresponding to (111) and (211) planes of Ni₂P and (100) plane of Fe₂P.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The interplanar spacings determined by high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) and shown in Figure 1f are 0.221, 0.167, and 0.508 nm, corresponding to the (111) and (211) planes of Ni₂P and the (100) plane of Fe₂P, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM reveals heterostructure with phase boundary between Ni₂P and Fe₂P phases.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The heterostructure, which can produce an interfacial bonding effect and is beneficial for exposing more active sites, can be directly observed by the phase boundary between the Ni₂P and Fe₂P phases marked in Figure 1f.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED ring patterns reveal characteristic (001) and (200) facets of Fe₂P and (111) and (210) facets of Ni₂P.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ring patterns from selected area electron diffraction (SAED) shown in Figure 1g reveal the characteristic (001) and (200) facets of Fe₂P and the (111) and (210) facets of Ni₂P...

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX mapping shows uniform distribution of Ni, Fe, and P elements with Fe atomic ratio around 3.2%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The evenly distributed Ni, Fe, and P shown in the EDS mapping images of the Ni₂P-Fe₂P/NF sample (Figure S10d-f, Supporting Information) demonstrate that this synthesis method can result in a homogeneous Ni₂P-Fe₂P product in which the atomic ratio of Fe is around 3.2%.

nodes.evidence_snippet: The heterogeneous Ni₂P-Fe₂P/NF exhibits the largest Cdl (12.3 mF cm⁻²) among the three samples studied... (307.5 cm⁻² ECSA, Figure S14, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₂P-Fe₂P/NF shows charge transfer resistance Rct ≈ 2.1 Ω; Ni₂P-Ni₅P₄/NF shows Rct ≈ 7.4 Ω.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Rct of Ni₂P-Fe₂P/NF (≈ 2.1Ω) is much smaller than that of Ni₂P-Ni₅P₄/NF (≈ 7.4Ω), confirming that the bimetallic phosphide Ni₂P-Fe₂P/NF has enhanced conductivity.
